verdict: Meta delivering strong leads; Google spend needs an immediate audit.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 118 leads at an average cost of $24.75 per lead — all of them from Meta, where efficiency is genuinely improving: week-over-week, leads rose 33% while cost per lead fell 41%. At the same time, $1,850 was spent on Google Ads over the same window with zero conversions, and that campaign is now under an immediate audit to either fix the setup or redirect the budget to what is working. On the lead-to-appointment side, 118 paid leads entered your pipeline but none have progressed to a booked appointment, so we are reviewing the intake and follow-up flow to close that gap. Next period, you should expect a cleaner Google Ads picture — either confirmed performance or reallocated spend — and new ad creative and landing pages launching before month end.
